I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Reduced motion now disables the card border transition and win banner pulse, as required by V17 and V18. The normal 120 ms transition and 600 ms pulse remain unchanged.

- [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css:18)
- [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css:33)
